name: Nomad Wear
author: nomadwear

sections.description:
Nomad Wear is a WooCommerce extension that integrates with Nomad Wear (https://nomadwear.ae/) to retrieve shipping rates, synchronize orders, update order statuses, and manage order returns.

This plugin is designed for WooCommerce stores that use Nomad Wear as a third-party logistics and order management service.

Core Functionality

  • Retrieves shipping rates from Nomad Wear and displays them at WooCommerce checkout
  • Displays a configurable Nomad Wear information or promotion box on product pages
  • Synchronizes WooCommerce orders with Nomad Wear after checkout
  • Updates WooCommerce order status based on status changes received from Nomad Wear
  • Allows administrators to enable or disable order return management
  • Uses WordPress and WooCommerce hooks and APIs

Third-Party Services

This plugin communicates with Nomad Wear services to function correctly.

Service Details

  • Service Name: Nomad Wear
  • Service URL: https://nomadwear.ae/
  • Purpose: Shipping rate calculation, order synchronization, order status updates, and return management
  • Data Sent: Order details, shipping address, cart items, order status
  • When Data Is Sent: During checkout, after order placement, and during order status synchronization
  • Privacy Policy: https://nomadwear.ae/privacy-policy

By using this plugin, you agree to the NomadWear terms and privacy policy.

Configuration

  1. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Shipping → Nomad Wear
  2. Enable this shipping method
  3. Enter the required details:

API URL

https://nomadwear.ae

API Key

Available in your Nomad wear Dashboard → Settings → API Key

  1. Save changes.

After saving, Nomad Wear Shipping rates will be available at checkout for supported locations.

Order Synchronization

When a customer places an order using Nomad Wear Shipping, the order is automatically synchronized with the Nomad wear system.

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the nomad-shipping folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
    OR
  2. Install the plugin via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
sections.faq:
Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Does this plugin work without a Nomad Wear account?

No. Valid API credentials from Nomad Wear are required.

Can individual features be disabled?

Yes. Features can be enabled or disabled from the settings page.

Is customer data sent to Nomad Wear?

Yes. Order and shipping information are sent to NomadWear to provide shipping and fulfillment services.

Does this plugin support refunds?

Refund processing depends on Nomad Wear return workflows and WooCommerce configuration.
